dict.string: Pulsar listens only while you hold ⌃⌥, ⌃⌘ or ⌃⇧, to turn your voice into text or a command. Nothing is recorded.
Pulsar turns what you say into text while you hold the voice keys, on your Mac when possible.
Pulsar turns Bluetooth on and off from the Controls tile in the notch island.
Pulsar uses system automation to switch Dark Mode and empty the Trash, and to read what plays in Spotify and in your browser for the notch island.
Pulsar shows a small moon in the notch island when Do Not Disturb turns on or off.
Pulsar shows your next event today in the notch island. Nothing leaves your Mac.
